## 1. Cross-check against an independent MLX port

Same adapter tensors, same backbone weights, same token ids, fed to this repo's hook-based port and to [elimaine/delta-mem-mlx-sidecar](https://github.com/elimaine/delta-mem-mlx-sidecar) (commit `c946764a1fd1`), which re-implements the attention body. Prefill only, fresh state, 3 prompts.

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| max abs Δ of final logits | 0.0 |
| top-1 token identical on every prompt | True |
| min cosine between the ports' final states | 1.000000000000 |
| max abs Δ between the ports' final states | 1.192e-06 |
| backbone-only (sidecar detached) max abs Δ | 0.0 |
| adapter tensors bit-identical in both ports | True |
| distinct model objects / backbone weights | True / True |

Per prompt, first layer whose hidden state differs between the ports:

| Prompt | Kind | Tokens | First divergent layer | Attribution |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| fact | one-line fact | 15 | None | none: every layer's hidden state is bit-identical between the ports |
| paragraph | 40-token paragraph | 48 | None | none: every layer's hidden state is bit-identical between the ports |
| instruction | short instruction | 16 | None | none: every layer's hidden state is bit-identical between the ports |

## 2. Cost on this Mac

1024-token prompt, 128 greedy tokens, 3 repeats after one warm-up, medians. Peak memory from `mx.get_peak_memory` (reset before every run), max over the runs, weights included.

| Configuration | Prefill tok/s | Decode tok/s | Peak memory |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| vanilla | 6209.9 | 158.23 | 3.17 GiB |
| sidecar | 729.2 | 112.42 | 2.69 GiB |
| sidecar / vanilla | ×0.117 | ×0.711 | -494.3 MiB |

Raw repeats (prefill tok/s · decode tok/s · peak):

| Configuration | Run 1 | Run 2 | Run 3 | Greedy output identical across runs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| vanilla | 6181.6 · 158.23 · 3.17 GiB | 6212.6 · 158.25 · 3.17 GiB | 6209.9 · 158.15 · 3.17 GiB | True |
| sidecar | 724.4 · 112.31 · 2.69 GiB | 729.2 · 112.94 · 2.69 GiB | 734.8 · 112.42 · 2.69 GiB | True |

Model load 0.3 s (2.11 GiB active); adapter attach + load 0.02 s (2.13 GiB active afterwards).

## 3. Persistence, short context (Part C)

5 invented facts. Turn 1: one user message stating the fact; chat template, user turn, no assistant header; prefill only. Turn 2: fresh prompt without turn 1: the question; chat template, user turn + assistant header; fresh KV cache. Log-prob: log-softmax at the last position of turn 2, of the first token of the answer tokenised on its own. Greedy: argmax decoding, max 8 tokens, stop at EOS; hit = answer contained in the output, case-insensitive.

| Fact | Answer | (a) vanilla log-p | (b) sidecar log-p | (c) reset log-p | greedy a / b / c |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| varuna-codename | Kestrel-7 | -6.262 | -3.973 | -3.935 | miss / miss / miss |
| halvorsen-password | tangerine-moss | -19.000 | -5.330 | -5.555 | miss / miss / miss |
| orrery-oncall | Priyanka Vashti | -14.158 | -8.376 | -8.514 | miss / miss / miss |
| meridian-serial | QX-4471-B | -12.025 | -6.945 | -7.222 | miss / miss / miss |
| tamarind-train | Saffron Lantern | -8.377 | -3.506 | -3.449 | miss / miss / miss |
| **mean** | | -11.965 | -5.626 | -5.735 | 0 / 0 / 0 hits |

(b) > (a) on the first-token log-prob: 5/5. (b) > (c): 3/5. Both: 3/5. The (b)–(a) gap is the adapter being attached at all (compare (c), which has the adapter but no memory); the (b)–(c) gap is the memory.

Item 0 (worked example from the model card): not run: the card carries a loading snippet (attach_delta_mem / load_delta_mem_adapter) and a details table, but no prompt/answer example — nothing to run verbatim.
